newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR TIGHTLY MIXED BUT TRADE MINIMAL.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR TIGHTLY MIXED BUT TRADE MINIMAL.

text.p: White sugar futures were slow to react to the initially weak performance in New York with ranges on nearby contracts only widening marginally, traders said on Tuesday.
Volume stood at a paltry 447 lots by 1415 GMT although positions were still tightly mixed.

The front-month October contract recorded the widest range at $1.00, straddling its open of $323.00 -- the high of Monday's session reached after a bout of trade buying counterbalances speculator sales.
October was 30 cents lower at $322.60 and December down 60 cents at $320.30.
The Paris market was marginally firmer but again volume was thin, amounting to 165 lots. October was up 70 cents at $323.00 and December up $1.20 at $321.00.
